summary: Verified fix for ChunkLoadError on /parts page. PartsInventory is now eagerly imported (not lazy), ErrorBoundary has auto-recovery for chunk errors. All tests pass - no ChunkLoadError or Unexpected token '<' errors.
passed_tests: ✅ PartsInventory uses eager import (line 14 in App.js) instead of lazy
✅ ErrorBoundary has auto-recovery logic for ChunkLoadError/Unexpected token
✅ ErrorBoundary uses sessionStorage to prevent infinite reload loops
✅ Navigation to /parts after login shows Parts Inventory page
✅ Parts Inventory page renders with all components (Smart Inventory, Alerts, OCR, Stats)
context_for_next_testing_agent: ChunkLoadError bug on /parts is fixed. PartsInventory is now eagerly imported. ErrorBoundary has auto-recovery that reloads once if ChunkLoadError or 'Unexpected token <' detected, using sessionStorage key 'chunk-reload-attempted' to prevent infinite loops.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: PartsInventory was lazy loaded with React.lazy() causing ChunkLoadError when the chunk file was missing or stale. Fix: Changed to eager import on line 14 of App.js. Additionally, ErrorBoundary now catches these errors and attempts one auto-reload before showing fallback UI.
